<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—a dominant M peak at 114 m/z, an M+1 peak at ~6.7 % intensity, and much smaller higher‑order peaks—the pattern matches the typical 13C isotopic distribution of a molecule containing several carbons. No characteristic M+2 pattern of Cl, Br, or S is present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
